note: The built core combines this repository's integration with DuckStation as it stood at its last GPL-3.0 commit, and is distributed under the GPL-3.0, which is that DuckStation's own licence and the strongest term in the package. Everything else it links is permissive and travels inside those terms: fmt, fast_float, simpleini, rapidyaml and Dear ImGui are MIT; xxHash, libchdr and Zstandard are BSD; zlib is under the zlib licence; the LZMA SDK is public domain. No BIOS and no game is part of this package - a PlayStation needs a ROM dump the user supplies, and it never enters this repository.

components.name: chimera-core-duckstation (integration)
components.license: MIT, and DuckStation's terms (GPL-3.0) for patches/, waterbox/host.cpp and waterbox/audio-stream.cpp

components.name: DuckStation
components.note: Pinned at the last commit of DuckStation offered under the GPL-3.0 (2024-09-01). Later versions are under CC BY-NC-ND 4.0 and nothing from them is in this package. Its per-title database (data/resources/gamedb.yaml) is compiled into the core.

components.name: Dear ImGui
components.note: Compiled because DuckStation's own files include it for their debug windows; no context is ever created and nothing is drawn with it.
